home.about_text: We’re a small, friendly shop specialising in vintage bicycles and reliable repairs. Our team loves helping riders keep the classics on the road.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: Founded by local enthusiasts, Evelyn Wharf Cycles restores and services vintage bicycles and supports modern commuters with dependable repairs. Our approach is hands-on and customer friendly.
values: Quality repairs with honest, straightforward advice
Respect for vintage bicycles and correct restoration
